summary.text: Dick Bradstreet, a Republican, represents Maine Senate District 15, which covers Augusta, Belgrade, China, Mount Vernon, Sidney and Vassalboro in Kennebec County. The Maine Legislature's profile lists committee assignments to Labor and Engrossed Bills.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists legislative service as Senate 132 and House 128-131.
